description: Message/changes, SpaceBan/changes, ChatContact/changes, CustomEmoji/changes, SpaceInvite/changes, ReadPosition/changes, PresenceStatus/changes all omit the required updatedProperties field. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires it. Chat/changes and Space/changes were fixed; these 7 were not. A conformant client calling any of these will receive an invalid response.
title: updatedProperties missing from 7 chat-server /changes handlers
